sourceCopy.name: Sobriety Day Counter
sourceCopy.title: Sobriety Day Counter Free | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Count calendar days from a date you choose, see personal milestones, and optionally keep a private note on this device.
sourceCopy.intro: Choose a start date to count elapsed calendar days and see upcoming milestones. This private counter is not treatment, recovery advice, or a measure of health.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: How does the sobriety day counter work?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: It counts whole calendar days from the date you enter through today. The selected start date itself is day zero; later dates use date-only arithmetic, so daylight-saving time does not add or remove a day.
sourceCopy.privacyQuestion: Is my sobriety date uploaded or saved?
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No data is uploaded. Your dates are used in this browser only. A note or date can be saved on this device only if you explicitly opt in, and you can clear the local record at any time.

fields.startDateHint: Enter the date you want to count from. A date today is day zero; future dates are not allowed.
fields.todayHint: Defaults to today and can be changed to review an earlier date, but not a date before the start.
fields.noteHint: Up to 280 characters. Keep sensitive details out of shared devices.
fields.saveConsent: Save this date and note on this device
fields.privacyNote: Saving is optional and uses this browser’s local storage only; nothing is uploaded. Clear saved data below.
fields.chartDescription: Timeline showing completed and upcoming personal milestones
fields.accuracyNote: This is date arithmetic only. It does not assess substance use, health, risk, progress, or treatment needs. Recovery is personal; consider qualified support if you want help.

messages.copyUnavailable: Copy is not available in this browser.
messages.saveUnavailable: This browser could not save local data.
messages.deleted: Saved entries cleared from this device.

additionalFaqs.question: Does the start date count as day one?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. The chosen start date is day zero. The next calendar date is one elapsed day later.

additionalFaqs.question: Can this counter give recovery or medical advice?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. It counts calendar days and displays milestones only. It does not assess health, substance use, treatment or personal progress.

additionalFaqs.question: Are dates and notes sent to a server?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. Calculations run in your browser. Saving is optional and stores a small record in this browser on this device; you can clear it here.
